clips.title: The Polished Summary Trap
clips.summary: A finished-looking AI report can make unverified claims feel already checked.

clips.title: What Confidence Debt Means
clips.summary: Confidence debt is what happens when trust moves downstream faster than evidence.

clips.title: The Wrong Artifact Travels
clips.summary: The dangerous artifact is often the one that is easiest to read, forward, and approve.

clips.title: Transparency Is Not Friction
clips.summary: Showing the warning label is not enough when the workflow still lets the mistake through.

clips.title: The Pass@1 Dashboard Trap
clips.summary: A one-shot benchmark score is not a deployment argument for repeated real-world work.

clips.title: Friction Is the Training Load
clips.summary: Removing all friction also removes the practice that keeps correction capacity alive.

clips.title: The Human-in-the-Loop Liability Shield
clips.summary: A tired reviewer staring at fluent AI output is not automatically a governance mechanism.

clips.title: The Doctrine of Friction
clips.summary: The fix is not less AI. It is enforced evidence, reliability, and correction practice.

clips.title: Thursday at 4:45 Is the Danger Zone
clips.summary: Confidence debt often starts when fatigue meets a polished AI artifact.

clips.title: You Endorsed What You Did Not Verify
clips.summary: The panic arrives when you realize the confidence you forwarded was never earned.

clips.title: The Beautiful Report Was Lying
clips.summary: The clean summary was not merely imperfect. Its core mapping was hallucinated.

clips.title: Borrowing Trust From Formatting
clips.summary: A document can imply that verification happened even when no one actually paid that cost.

clips.title: Generation Is Not the Bottleneck
clips.summary: When AI can generate fluent reports cheaply, the hard problem becomes tracing evidence.

clips.title: Expired Confidence Is Still Dangerous
clips.summary: A summary can keep looking true after the evidence underneath it has expired.

clips.title: AI Agents Drift Into the Ditch
clips.summary: Small errors can compound across a long task until correction capacity is exceeded.

clips.title: Confidence Debt Compounds Into a Cascade
clips.summary: Artifact trust, dashboard scores, and passive review can finance each other into failure.
